scenarios.proof: After READY completed, a peer send started a new turn without additional stdin, incidental hook or polling prompt. Actual MCP receipt and correlated nonce reply followed.

ask_human ran from 18:07:45 to its expected 45-second timeout. Peer then canonical-human sends were accepted at 18:08:01 and remained queued. A terminal prompt was submitted before 18:08:13.928 while the tool waited. Both message IDs were acknowledged and replied to in daemon order after the tool result; the terminal prompt was also answered. This is one bounded ordering case, not a general starvation proof.
A second idle peer message received explicit acknowledgement and a nonce reply while the PTY still displayed the exact unsubmitted draft. No Enter or terminal injection delivered the peer text.

profile_guard.reason: Global .claude.json hash changed during the concurrent-session trial. Original result retained; user files were not restored.
profile_guard.investigation: Both original before/after hashes matched retained Claude backup bytes. Recursive JSON comparison found only the following usage-counter paths changed. No authentication, MCP entries, provider settings or other monitored configuration changed. Attribution between concurrent Claude processes is not established.
profile_guard.authentication: Existing access token supplied only in the child environment; no login or refresh requested.

prior_attempt.configuration_difference: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 in an otherwise isolated profile prevented channel feature discovery. Removing that flag in the next fresh trial enabled development-channel consent and channel registration.
prior_attempt.proof: Provider debug reported channel notifications skipped. The queued fixture remained unacknowledged and had no reply. No model prompt was submitted.

native_ui.scope:
Exercise production Iced controls in owned fixture state, then reopen the app.

Scenarios invoke callbacks collected from the actual rendered controls. This checks
native rendering and action wiring; it is not physical keyboard or screen-reader testing.

idle_resources.method: 12 ps RSS/CPU samples one second apart after 3s warmup; ordinary window without smoke polling; CPU is ps-reported, not a battery or power measurement

notification_navigation.scope:
Exercise notification navigation through real desktop processes and private IPC.

This tests existing-window and cold-start routing with actual daemon state and
rendered controls. It does not simulate or claim a Notification Center click.
Native sender authorization and physical notification clicks are separate trials.

Retained in the bulk-receipt report; cause remains unresolved. Fresh native repeat does not explain the original failure.
